acceptance_criteria: Independent prospective or external dysarthric speech cohort (e.g. UASpeech or clinical registry) acquired with 0% TORGO overlap
stop_condition: Do not unlock confirmation runner until cohort acquired and validated

acceptance_criteria: Official dataset version custodian contact accession ID and collection metadata cryptographically registered
stop_condition: Halt processing if dataset provenance or custodial authorization is unverifiable

acceptance_criteria: Bilateral signed DUA executing lawful research data transfer and permitted-use scope without clinical dispatch rights
stop_condition: Do not ingest data if DUA is unexecuted or commercial/dispatch use is restricted

acceptance_criteria: Documented stamped approval letter or formal exemption determination from accredited Institutional Review Board (IRB/IEC)
stop_condition: Immediate halt of all pilot recruitment or evaluation upon ethics lapse or unapproved protocol

acceptance_criteria: Validated informed consent forms detailing voluntary participation voice-biometric handling data retention and revocation rights
stop_condition: Do not record or evaluate participants without verifiable executed consent

acceptance_criteria: Formal appointment letter and protocol endorsement signed by licensed Speech-Language Pathologist (CCC-SLP) and Medical Director
stop_condition: Suspend pilot evaluation if clinical oversight or SLP supervision is unappointed

acceptance_criteria: ExternalDatasetValidator.validate_manifest() returns is_valid=True with valid SHA-256 and zero schema violations
stop_condition: Fail closed if manifest SHA-256 mismatches or mandatory schema fields are missing

acceptance_criteria: Zero speaker ID utterance ID or acoustic biometric overlap with TORGO 15-speaker baseline corpus
stop_condition: Reject cohort immediately if any TORGO speaker or utterance identity is detected

acceptance_criteria: Deterministic verification that prospective confirmation partition shares zero sessions with development/calibration splits
stop_condition: Halt evaluation if train/dev/test split leakage or cross-session duplication is identified

acceptance_criteria: Independent dual clinical annotation with inter-rater kappa >= 0.85 for emergency-intent ground truth labels
stop_condition: Block confirmatory evaluation if ground truth emergency labels lack inter-rater clinical reliability

acceptance_criteria: Formal written sign-off on clustered variance handling Wilson score intervals power calculations and primary endpoints
stop_condition: Do not execute confirmatory analysis until SAP is formally signed and dated

acceptance_criteria: Public preregistration of frozen protocol YAML and SAP SHA-256 on Open Science Framework (OSF) prior to unblinding
stop_condition: Halt confirmatory unlock if preregistration timestamp does not precede data acquisition

acceptance_criteria: All 15 speaker sidecar matrices (X_train_pca.npy) materialized and verified with zero float discrepancy against historical Gram cache
stop_condition: Fail closed with HTTP 503 if any speaker reference matrix is missing or tampered

acceptance_criteria: Operating cutoff tau=0.60 explicitly decoupled from internal FER ceiling (0.1500) and disclosed as THRESHOLD_PROVENANCE_UNVERIFIED
stop_condition: Halt if decision threshold is conflated with safety ceiling or tuned on locked test data

prerequisite_name: Stop Rules & Adverse Event Plan Approval
acceptance_criteria: Formal endorsement of automated stop rules (FER > 1.0% or 2 consecutive false dispatches trigger immediate session kill)
stop_condition: Immediate shutdown of pilot session if any stop condition is breached

acceptance_criteria: ConfirmatoryRunner enforces token authentication protocol locking single-pass locks and dry-run defaults with zero bypasses
stop_condition: Block runner execution if token is default/placeholder or dry-run flag is overridden without authorization

acceptance_criteria: Documented signed executive decision memo and authorization token issued by Project Owner
stop_condition: Never mark Gate C passed based solely on code or documentation presence without explicit owner sign-off
